questionText: You receive a data breach alert. What is your first action?

feedback.title: Transparent Approach
feedback.text: You prioritize customer trust. This builds long-term loyalty but may cause short-term panic.

feedback.title: Cautious Approach
feedback.text: You gather facts first. This is prudent but may violate breach notification laws.

alternatives.text: Call legal and PR teams for a coordinated response

feedback.title: Coordinated Response
feedback.text: You bring in experts. This is the most professional approach — balanced and legally sound.
